description: Define ONE calm, uniform skeleton treatment and apply it to the skeleton primitives and the shared page-shaped placeholders. The user finds the skeletons too detailed and visually uneven. The fix is to reduce INNER TEXTURE and even out VISUAL WEIGHT while preserving every reserved dimension, breakpoint gate, and outer structure so nothing shifts when real data arrives (hard rule in .kiro/steering/structure.md: 'Arriving data must not move anything outside its own region'). This feature establishes the rule and lands it in the two highest-leverage shared files. FEAT-002 then propagates the same rule to the remaining per-feature and per-route skeletons.
steps: THE RULE (adopt verbatim; FEAT-002 reuses it). (a) UNIFORM FILL: leave components/ui/skeleton.tsx's Skeleton base ('animate-skeleton rounded-md bg-muted/70') and the globals.css animation UNCHANGED - the single uniform fill/opacity already lives there. Do NOT touch app/globals.css. (b) DROP SHAPED TEXTURE: where a Skeleton is drawn as a filled circle ('rounded-full') or a badge-shaped box PURELY as texture inside a text line (not reserving its own layout column), render it as the default neutral 'rounded-md' box of the SAME reserved size instead of mimicking the final shape. (c) EVEN THE WIDTHS: collapse the wide spread of literal/texture bar widths to a small canonical set so weight reads even. For TextLines text runs use only: 'w-1/3' (short line), 'w-1/2' (medium), 'w-2/3' (long), 'w-full' (full), and keep a final-line taper of 'w-1/3' or 'w-1/2' for the last wrapped line. (d) KEEP LOAD-BEARING GEOMETRY: do NOT change any width/height that reserves real space - fixed control heights (h-9/h-11/h-8), image frames and aspect ratios, tab-strip ch-sized labels, size-N boxes that occupy their own column, min-h-* rows, grid definitions, breakpoint-gated visibility, safe-area insets, and the TextLines type-scale classes. Change texture, keep footprint.

DISTINGUISHING TEXTURE FROM GEOMETRY (apply this test at every Skeleton/TextLines site): a width/shape is TEXTURE if changing it does not move anything outside the element's own box - e.g. a bar inside a flex-1 region, a fraction width inside a min-w-0 text column, a chat-bubble height inside a flex-1 justify-end log, a decorative avatar circle whose text column beside it is taller than it is. A width/shape is GEOMETRY if other content's position depends on it - e.g. a fixed-px control, an avatar that is the tallest thing in its row, an aspect-ratio image frame, a ch-sized tab label, a two-count row grid. Only change TEXTURE.

components/ui/skeleton.tsx: leave Skeleton and TextLines implementations unchanged (they are correct and already the single tuning point). Update the TextLines JSDoc to note the project convention that texture widths should come from the small canonical set {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full} so weight stays even, while load-bearing fractions/px are kept. Do not alter runtime behavior.

components/contract/ContractRoomSkeleton.tsx (the file in the user's screenshot - canonical 'too busy' example): REMOVE the shaped texture while keeping all geometry. Specifically: (1) In the ContractHeader card, the two party-line 'size-6 rounded-full' avatar circles with w-10/w-20 name bars read as decorative texture - replace the two avatar circles with nothing OR a single calm neutral box only if it reserves height; since the row height is set by the text line beside them (text-body) and the badge, collapse the party cluster to at most one uniform neutral chip plus one 'w-1/3' TextLines, dropping the second avatar+name pair. Keep the title TextLines (w-40 is fine as geometry-ish; you may normalize to 'w-1/3'), the BadgeSkeleton, and the money TextLines. (2) BadgeSkeleton: keep it (it reserves honest badge height from the type scale) but it stays a plain rounded-md box - no change needed. (3) ChatBarSkeleton: keep the subject thumbnail 'size-9 rounded-md' (geometry). The back-chevron 'size-9 rounded-full' is a real control reserve - keep it but it is already neutral. In the subline, collapse the three varied widths (w-12, badge, w-20) - keep the BadgeSkeleton and reduce the text bars to the canonical set. (4) The lg details tab strip currently uses ['w-10','w-12','w-14','w-16'] - these are texture inside min-h-11 fixed cells; replace with a single uniform width (e.g. all 'w-12') so the four tabs read even, OR keep ch-approximate but uniform. (5) The 6-row detail list ['w-24','w-20','w-28','w-16','w-24','w-20'] label column: replace all six with ONE uniform width ('w-1/3' of the label side, or keep a single literal like 'w-20' applied to all six) and keep the value column 'w-24' uniform - this is the single biggest source of visual noise. (6) The chat-bubble logs: the varied heights (h-10/h-12/h-16) and widths (w-1/2, w-2/3, w-3/5, w-2/5) are explicitly texture ('bubbles are texture rather than geometry'). Make every bubble ONE uniform height (pick h-12) and a small alternating width set (e.g. incoming 'w-2/3', outgoing 'w-1/2' with ml-auto) so the log reads calm and even. Keep the rounded-2xl, the gap-cozy, the justify-end anchoring, and the number of bubbles. Update the header/inline comments to describe the new calmer approach rather than deleting the geometry reasoning.

components/layout/WorkspaceSkeletons.tsx (47 skeleton usages, propagates everywhere): apply the rule to inner texture while keeping ALL imported geometry constants (CONTRACT_ROW_GRID, SECTION_TABS_*_SHAPE, MESSAGE_GUTTER, PANE_BAR_MIN_H) and all fixed heights. Specifically: (1) ContractRowSkeleton: keep the 'size-12 md:size-14 rounded-md' thumb (geometry, its own column). The title/meta/next-step TextLines widths (w-full, w-2/5, w-3/5, w-4/5, w-1/2) - normalize to the canonical set keeping the two-line-vs-one-line distinction and the w-full first line. Keep the status badge 'h-6 w-20 rounded-md' reserves (geometry). (2) OfferRowSkeleton: keep the 'size-10 rounded-md' thumb and the baseline-bearing badge box (both carry height). Normalize the text bar widths to canonical. (3) InboxRowSkeleton: the leading 'size-12 rounded-full' avatar sets no height (the 3-line text column beside it is taller) - it is decorative texture per the test, BUT the comments note it is part of the real row's measured height contribution; to be SAFE and avoid any shift, KEEP all size-N boxes here as neutral same-size boxes and only normalize the TextLines widths (w-1/3, w-3/4, w-12 -> canonical). Keep the 'size-6 rounded-full' secondary avatar and the 'h-5 w-16 rounded-full' pill as same-size neutral reserves. (4) ChatThreadSkeleton: same as ContractRoomSkeleton's logs - make the four bubbles uniform height (h-12) and a two-width alternating set; keep all bar heights in the composer/header (geometry). (5) SectionHeaderSkeleton, SectionFilterSkeleton, NotificationRowSkeleton: these are already mostly uniform; only normalize any stray texture widths to the canonical set, keep every fixed height and the ch-sized tab labels. Preserve/adjust the extensive load-bearing comments to match.
acceptance_criteria: components/ui/skeleton.tsx Skeleton and TextLines runtime behavior is unchanged; app/globals.css animate-skeleton is untouched.

In ContractRoomSkeleton.tsx and WorkspaceSkeletons.tsx, every chat-bubble stack uses ONE uniform height and at most two widths; the 6-row detail list and the tab-strip bars use a single uniform width each.
No filled-circle avatar or badge-shaped box that was pure texture mimics a final shape beyond a neutral same-size box; all boxes that reserve real layout space keep their exact dimensions.
Every fixed control height, image frame/aspect, grid constant, breakpoint gate, safe-area inset, min-h row, and TextLines type-scale class is preserved exactly - no reserved footprint changes.
Texture text-bar widths across both files are drawn only from the canonical set {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full} (plus honest load-bearing fractions/px that reserve space).
Load-bearing explanatory comments are preserved and updated to describe the calmer approach, not deleted.
verification: Visually re-read both edited files to confirm the diff only touches texture (widths, decorative shapes, bubble heights) and leaves every reserved dimension, breakpoint gate, and imported geometry constant intact.
Confirm no new imports were needed and no literal px heights/aspect ratios were altered.
DO NOT run build/test/lint/dev. Rely on editor diagnostics for TS correctness.
findings: Landed the calm/uniform skeleton rule in the 3 target files; app/globals.css untouched. (1) components/ui/skeleton.tsx: Skeleton + TextLines runtime UNCHANGED; added the canonical-width convention to the TextLines JSDoc (texture runs draw from {w-1/3, w-1/2, w-2/3, w-full}; load-bearing fractions/ch/px stay exact) and updated the @example to canonical widths. (2) components/contract/ContractRoomSkeleton.tsx: ContractHeader party cluster collapsed from two size-6 rounded-full avatars + w-10/w-20 names to ONE neutral size-6 rounded-md chip + one w-1/3 TextLines (dropped the second avatar+name pair; no rounded-full final-shape mimicry); title/money normalized to w-1/3. ChatBarSkeleton subline text runs -> canonical (BadgeSkeleton + size-9 controls kept as geometry, incl. the rounded-full back chevron control). ActionDockSkeleton text runs w-3/5/w-4/5 -> w-2/3. lg tab strip ['w-10','w-12','w-14','w-16'] -> all w-12 (min-h-11 cells kept). 6-row detail list label column ['w-24','w-20','w-28','w-16','w-24','w-20'] -> all w-20, value column stays uniform w-24. Phone log (3 bubbles) and lg log (5 bubbles): every bubble now h-12 with alternating w-2/3 incoming / w-1/2 ml-auto outgoing; counts, rounded-2xl, gap-cozy, justify-end preserved. (3) components/layout/WorkspaceSkeletons.tsx: ContractRowSkeleton title/meta/next-step -> canonical (kept w-full first line + two-line distinction; size-12/14 thumb and h-6 w-20 badge kept). OfferRowSkeleton text runs -> canonical (thumb + baseline-bearing badge kept). InboxRowSkeleton: KEPT all size-N circles/pills as same-size neutral reserves per the safe instruction, normalized only TextLines widths (w-3/4->w-2/3, w-12->w-1/3). ChatThreadSkeleton: 4 bubbles -> uniform h-12 alternating w-2/3/w-1/2; header title/meta -> w-1/3; composer/header fixed heights kept. NotificationRowSkeleton stray widths -> canonical. All imported geometry constants (CONTRACT_ROW_GRID, SECTION_TABS_*_SHAPE, MESSAGE_GUTTER, PANE_BAR_MIN_H), SectionHeaderSkeleton width props (w-40/w-64/w-36 caller-override reserves), SectionFilterSkeleton ch-sized labels, ContractCardListSkeleton market-label header cells, all fixed control heights, breakpoint gates and safe-area insets preserved unchanged. No new imports. All load-bearing comments preserved and updated to describe the calmer approach. Per user/steering rules, did NOT run build/typecheck/lint/test/dev. FEAT-002 propagates the same rule to the remaining per-feature/per-route skeletons.
